net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.ResizerFactory factory = net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.DefaultResizerFactory.getInstance();

// 1. Test ThumbnailParameterBuilder overload
net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameterBuilder()
    .size(100, 100)
    .resizerFactory(factory)
    .build();

assert param.getResizerFactory() == factory : "ResizerFactory was not set correctly on ThumbnailParameter";

// 2. Test Thumbnails.Builder overload
java.awt.image.BufferedImage result = net.coobird.thumbnailator.Thumbnails.of(sourceImage)
    .size(42, 42)
    .resizerFactory(factory)
    .asBufferedImage();

assert result.getWidth() <= 42 && result.getHeight() <= 42 : "Image was not resized correctly using the provided ResizerFactory";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ resizerFactory " + param.getResizerFactory().getClass().getSimpleName() + "_" + result.getWidth() + "x" + result.getHeight());
